**Needs changes before merge.**

Review tier: SAFETY. This PR adds a post, so it changes posted G-code. Built and tested locally, on a trial merge of head `f3721d6a8` with `upstream/main` `893e749c0`. The merge has no text conflicts.

## What looks good

- `g-edm.cps` has a provenance header. It names its public sources and says that no G-RBLv3 source was read. It uses no HSMWorks or Autodesk material.
- The post fails closed. A taper that is not a number (`NaN`) is refused as a taper. An arc with no centre is refused. Each refusal names the operation.
- The arc `I J` words use the same `IJKIncrement - Start` form as `wire-iso.cps` and `sodick-wire.cps` (`IJKIncrement` holds the absolute centre, `crates/post/src/post/cnc.rs:184-187`).
- "Generic ISO Wire EDM" stays `WIRE_POSTS[0]`. The test `g_edm_post_serves_wire_edms_only_and_is_never_the_default` pins this.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/2700-g-edm-post.md` gives the reason for each word that is not written, and for each dropped item.
- No existing golden changed. No snapshot PNG changed. No `CHANGELOG.md` edit. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #2700`.

## New golden, read line by line

`crates/app/tests/golden/nc/g-edm/wire_slug_punch.nc`:

- The header is comments only. Then `G21 G90 G17`.
- `G0 X-30. Y0.` goes to the stated start point `[-30, 0]`.
- The punch path is offset by 0.165 mm from the 40 x 20 slug. This is the wire radius 0.125 plus the R1 gap 0.04. The path is outside the slug on all four sides, so it does not cut into the slug. The outer corners are sharp line intersections, so they cut only material outside the slug.
- The lead-in and lead-out are on `Y0.`, from `X-30.` to `X-20.165`.
- `M30` is the last line. There is no `F`, `%`, `O`, `G4x`, `G54`, `Z`, `U` or `V` word.

## Results (local, trial merge with main)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Build `camcraft-app` tests | **FAILED**: `g_edm_post` does not compile (item 1) |
| `camcraft-app --test g_edm_post` (with the one-line local fix below) | 8 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test conformance` | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test wire_post` | 12 passed |
| `camcraft-app`: `posting`, `post_not_judged`, `post_script_options`, `post_serves_kind`, `post_serves_plasma`, `post_spindle_rule_all`, `post_unit_word`, `sodick_wire_post`, `sodick_wire_passes`, `wire_sharp_corners`, `wire_iso_decimal`, `wire_taper`, `wire_4axis`, `machine_library` | all passed (96 tests) |
| `camcraft-post`: lib, `script_g_edm`, `comment_escape` | 85, 11, 4 passed |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | stopped by the local time limit after 123 steps (all post steps, the app build): 0 failed. The other app steps did not run. |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| Heavy lanes (`app heavy: every target`, because `crates/app/src/posting.rs` changed) | not run |

The local fix was only to make the test compile for this review. It was not pushed.

Extra suites run: none were needed. The diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no import code. The new fixture `crates/app/tests/edm/g-edm-fixture.mch` is read only by `g_edm_post`, and that suite ran.

## Mutations (each guard turned off, the pins run, then restored)

- Skim guard off (`EdmCondition` while threaded): `g_edm_refuses_skims_by_name` red.
- G54-only guard off: `g_edm_refuses_what_the_controller_cannot_be_told` red.
- Rapid-while-threaded guard off (`onRapid`, `if (threaded)`): **all 8 app pins and all 11 script pins stay green** (item 2).

## Requested before merge

1. **The new test does not compile after a merge with main.** Main added the field `sharp_corners` to `WireContourOp` (commit `543e9f1f8`, #3207). The compiler gives this error:
   ```
   error[E0063]: missing field `sharp_corners` in initializer of `WireContourOp`
     --> crates/app/tests/g_edm_post.rs:67:14
   ```
   Fix: merge `origin/main` into the branch. Add `sharp_corners: false,` after `skims,` in `crates/app/tests/g_edm_post.rs:79`. The other wire tests on main use the same line. With that line, all 8 pins pass on the trial merge.

2. **The rapid-while-threaded refusal has no pin.** `assets/posts/g-edm.cps` `onRapid` writes no word. Its only guard is the refusal when `threaded` is true. If that guard is lost, a rapid after the first cut is dropped silently. The next `G1` then cuts a straight line from the last cut point. The verified path does not have that line. This is a silent wrong cut. Fix: add a pin in `crates/app/tests/g_edm_post.rs`. Insert a `MoveKind::Rapid` record between two cut moves of `records()`, and assert with `refused(...)`: a warning that holds "Punch1" and "rapid with the wire threaded", and no cut word after it.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The heavy plan reaches `app heavy: every target` (the change to `crates/app/src/posting.rs`). This is a `P6` `feat`. The heavy result is owed to the wave run before the merge at the cut (AGENTS.md "Owed heavy result").
- `crates/app/src/posting.rs` and `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs` merged cleanly with main at this time. The body lists the open PRs that touch the same tables.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the two findings of the review of `f3721d6a8`. The new head is `880e5e3d234f9783d3d66753abe1f3af093d2888`.

1. **The test did not compile after a merge with main.** I merged `upstream/main` into the branch (merge commits only, no rebase). I added `sharp_corners: false,` to the `WireContourOp` in `crates/app/tests/g_edm_post.rs`. The merge had four conflicts. In each one, both sides added a line, and I kept both:
   - `WIRE_POSTS` in `crates/app/src/posting.rs`: the Agie native post, then G-EDM. "Generic ISO Wire EDM" stays the first entry.
   - `BUILTINS` in `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs`.
   - `WIRE_POSTS` and `EXTENSIONS` in `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs`.
   - `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs`: the text-post count goes from 21 to 22. Main added Mach3. The Agie refusal count stays 1.

   `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` now says that `g-edm.cps` is the fourth `WIRE_POSTS` entry.
2. **The rapid-while-threaded refusal had no pin.** New pin: `g_edm_refuses_a_rapid_with_the_wire_threaded_by_name`. It puts a `MoveKind::Rapid` record between the first and the second cut. It asserts a warning that holds "Punch1" and "rapid with the wire threaded". It also asserts that the program has only the first cut line, so no cut follows the rapid. Mutation: with `if (false && threaded)` in `onRapid`, the pin is red. With the guard restored, the pin is green.

Results on head `880e5e3d2` (main `f35202134` merged):

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test g_edm_post`: 9 passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 797 steps, 0 failed, 1 stalled. The stalled step is `app build (--no-run)`. A cold build after `cargo clean` gave no output for 15 min. Each app suite then built and passed in its own step. This includes `g_edm_post`, `conformance`, `example_catalog`, `wire_post` and `mcp_setup_moves`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Heavy lanes: not run. AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" (#3556) gives no heavy step to a `P6` PR.

Note: after the first merge of main, `mcp_setup_moves` failed. That failure was on main (#3602), and #3603 fixed it. The second merge of main brought the fix in.

Please re-review this head.

**Review clean. The PR now conflicts with `main`: refresh it before merge.**

Review tier: SAFETY. This PR adds a post, so it changes posted G-code. This is a re-review of head `880e5e3d2` after the "Addressed" comment. Built and tested locally, on a trial merge of head `880e5e3d2` with `upstream/main` `16b205834`. That merge had no text conflicts.

## Findings of the review of `f3721d6a8`

1. **The new test did not compile after a merge with main.** Fixed in `30b0f9207`: `sharp_corners: false,` is in `crates/app/tests/g_edm_post.rs:80`. `g_edm_post` builds and passes (9 of 9) on the trial merge.
2. **The rapid-while-threaded refusal had no pin.** Fixed in `30b0f9207`: `g_edm_refuses_a_rapid_with_the_wire_threaded_by_name`. The test puts a `MoveKind::Rapid` record between the first and the second cut. It asserts the refusal that names "Punch1". It also asserts that the program has only the first cut line. I ran the mutation again (see below): the pin is red when the guard is off.

The merge resolutions of the author are correct. `WIRE_POSTS` keeps "Generic ISO Wire EDM" as entry 0, and "G-EDM Wire EDM" is entry 3 after `agie::POST`. `BUILTINS`, `embedded()`, `EXTENSIONS` and the text-post count (22) agree with main at `16b205834`.

`assets/posts/g-edm.cps`, the golden `wire_slug_punch.nc`, the 11 recorded refusals, the fixture `.mch` and the decision file did not change since `f3721d6a8`. The line-by-line reading of the golden in the earlier review stays valid.

## Results (local, trial merge with `16b205834`)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app --test g_edm_post` | 9 passed |
| `camcraft-app`: `conformance`, `wire_post`, `posting` | 7, 12, 17 passed |
| `camcraft-app`: `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work` | 37 passed (4 ignored), 1, 1 passed |
| `camcraft-app`: `post_serves_kind`, `sodick_wire_post`, `sodick_wire_passes`, `wire_iso_decimal`, `wire_sharp_corners`, `machine_library` | all passed |
| `camcraft-post`: `script_g_edm`, `comment_escape` | 11, 4 passed |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 799 steps, 0 failed, 1 stalled. The stalled step is `app build (--no-run)`: the link of all app test binaries gave no output for 15 min. After it, each app suite built and passed in its own step. The step is a build step and runs no test. |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 3 steps, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Extra suites run: `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work` (the diff adds a post). The diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no import code.

## Heavy lanes

`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`, run by this review on the trial merge: `app heavy` (every target), 215 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 33.7 min, release.

## Mutations (each guard off, the pins run, then restored)

- Rapid-while-threaded guard off (`onRapid`, `if (false && threaded)`): `g_edm_refuses_a_rapid_with_the_wire_threaded_by_name` red.
- One-section guard off (`if (false && wireSections > 1)`): `g_edm_refuses_what_the_controller_cannot_be_told` red.
- Taper guard off (`else if (false && taper !== 0)`): `g_edm_refuses_taper_four_axis_and_lean_by_name` red.
- All restored: 9 of 9 green.

## Goldens moved

None. Only new goldens are added, under `nc/g-edm/` and `recorded/golden/g-edm/`. This agrees with the body.

## Conflict with the newest `main` (not a finding of the code)

After the tests, `main` moved to `4dba7019d`. PR #3598 renamed the Agie post to "Native wire EDM job files". `git merge-tree` now gives one conflict:

- `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs`, the `WIRE_POSTS` list. Main changed the third entry on one line. This PR changed the same line to a list of four lines.

Resolution: keep the list of four lines, and use `("Native wire EDM job files", "agie-native")` as the third entry. `crates/app/src/posting.rs` and `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs` merge without a conflict. Main added no new post, so the count 22 stays. After the refresh, run `g_edm_post`, `conformance` and `comment_escape` again.

The label is `conflicts`. The review of this head is clean. A refresh that changes only the merge of main and this one conflict hunk is a DELTA class change.

## Notes (not blocking)

- None.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
